questions.explanation: Identifying which firms compete for the same customers and comparing their prices and capabilities is competitor analysis, often organised around strategic groups of similar rivals. Market segmentation groups customers, not competitors, and the other options describe unrelated tools. Knowing the competitive set is a foundation for positioning.
questions.hint: The firm is studying rivals, not customers or costs.

options.text: Competitor analysis and identifying strategic groups

options.misconception: confuses grouping competitors with grouping customers
mistakes a competitive map for a stage model
assumes the exercise is about cost and volume
